name: Uchuu Keiji Soldivan
original_name: 宇宙刑事ソルディバン
source:
One day, a group of UFO suddenly appear and they order people to join the Galaxy Union. After some twists and turns, they decide to join it. This is a story about the space police, fighting against criminals who ran away from other planets....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090506001847/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009486]Erogeshop[/url]]
translation:
一天，一群UFO突然出现，并命令人们加入银河联盟。经历一番波折后，他们决定加入。这是一个关于宇宙刑警与从其他星球逃来的罪犯战斗的故事…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090506001847/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009486]Erogeshop[/url]]
